content:
alex: Heads-up: CI SAST + DAST jobs started failing after the keystore RBAC update at 08:47. Getting KMS Decrypt AccessDenied from scanner SA.

rachel: I removed group infra-keystore-read in the terraform roll earlier to clean up stale entries. Didn't realize scanner SA was transitively in that group.

sanjay: Error snippet from runner:
```
2026-04-21T08:50:12Z ERROR kms:Decrypt denied for serviceAccount:scanner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
request_id=xyz-789
key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/keystore/cryptoKeys/sast-key
```

sec-bot: Alert: 9 failing jobs (sast/dast) in the last 7m. Creating incident if not resolved in 10m.

dave: For quick recovery we can either re-add the SA to the group or grant cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter on the key to the scanner SA with a short TTL. Prefer group revert for minimal iam policy surface but want clear audit.

rachel: I can revert the group removal now but want infra lead sign-off. Also will add a PR note describing the dependency so it's not dropped again.

sanjay: Can ops-oncall confirm whether granting the role temporarily will show up as an auditable change? We need to capture who requested it from CI runs.

ops-oncall: Emergency grant OK. Please use infra-automation to apply with a 3h TTL and include a label: "sast-emergency-grant". Also open an incident ticket and attach the terraform change for audit.

rachel: Filed PR: https://git.internal.redwood/infra/iam/pulls/694 — two commits: (1) emergency grant to scanner SA with TTL via automation, (2) revert of my earlier group removal. PR includes terraform comment and a note to add preflight test.

sanjay: Running quick smoke re-runs.

sec-bot: Job re-run status: 7/9 passed, 2 queued.

alex: Thanks. Post-incident follow-ups we need: 1) a staging preflight that runs a scoped decrypt with the plan author identity before merging any keystore RBAC changes; 2) an alert on KMS Decrypt error rate >5/min to eng-security and pager; 3) ensure KMS audit logs include CI job id, repo, and actor (add annotation header in CI requests). 4) add a checklist item to PR template for any keystore/iam change listing dependent services.

dave: Also recommend a runbook: if scanner SA loses decrypt perms, ops can toggle a short TTL grant then escalate to infra owner for a permanent fix.

ops-oncall: Incident created INC-2026-0421-17 with timeline and logs. Assigning postmortem to @alex and @rachel.

rachel: I'll revert the group removal after TTL expires and follow up with infra leads tomorrow. Adding a note to oncall playbook about verifying SA group memberships before prune.

sanjay: I'll add the decrypt smoke-test to infra CI: use a dedicated test key and test SA that mirrors prod bindings.

alex: Good. Closing loop once postmortem is posted. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
